paragraphs.text: Najal is an efreet wizard from Rabiah , who currently resides on Dominaria .

From time immemorial, Najal claimed to be the fastest efreet in the infinite expanse of Rabiah , her homeworld. When another of her tribe challenged her to a race, Najal was pushed to her limits when suddenly, she was beset by a desert cyclone and found herself lost in the Tivan Desert on Dominaria. Najal is not a Planeswalker and is unsure whether she could ever recreate this feat, but having run so fast that she crossed dimensional barriers, even once affords her enough bragging rights for now.
